draft_frames.entity_name: ground-level urban street with the MetaX bus-stop shelter
draft_frames.purpose: lock the street scene space, shelter set dressing, daylight and grade for shot 1
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference photograph, no people and no animals. A ground-level urban street corner in front of a beige stone building, with a modern bus-stop shelter whose panel carries the three-dimensional capital lettering "MetaX". Warm afternoon daylight, long soft shadows on the pavement, a sidewalk with low set dressing, medium background density, warm amber color grade, light film grain, stylized retro documentary realism, horizontal 16:9 composition, shelter centered.
must_include: ground-level city street in front of a beige stone building
modern bus-stop shelter as the centered object
MetaX lettering on the shelter panel
long soft ground shadow
warm amber grade with light grain

draft_frames.entity_name: building exterior with the vertical MetaX fabric banner
draft_frames.purpose: lock the building facade space, banner set dressing, overcast sky and grade for shot 2
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference photograph, no people and no animals. A tall beige stone building facade seen from a low upward angle, carrying a large vertical white fabric banner printed with the capital lettering "MetaX" down its length. Cloudy overcast sky above, weathered stone surface, the banner hanging straight, warm amber grade over the cool overcast light, light film grain, stylized retro documentary realism, horizontal 16:9 composition, the vertical banner centered.
must_include: low-angle view of a tall building facade
large vertical white fabric banner with MetaX lettering
cloudy sky
beige weathered stone material
warm amber grade over overcast light

draft_frames.entity_name: open rooftop with the 3D MetaX lettering structure
draft_frames.purpose: lock the rooftop space, lettering structure, sky depth and grade for shot 3
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference photograph, no people and no animals. An open rooftop terrace with a low parapet and oversized three-dimensional block lettering reading "MetaX" mounted on the roof structure. Cloudy sky beyond the parapet, warm daylight, clean concrete rooftop surface, medium background density, warm amber color grade, light film grain, stylized retro documentary realism, horizontal 16:9 composition, the lettering behind a clear foreground area.
must_include: open rooftop terrace with a low parapet
oversized three-dimensional MetaX lettering on the roof structure
cloudy sky beyond the parapet
warm daylight
clear foreground area in front of the lettering
